candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order:8000/v1/orders returns HTTP 500; the order service is the failing dependency producing the gateway 5xx.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/traces and the specific order failure (e.g., DB, payment, inventory) are not in evidence; only the gateway's view of the 500 is observed.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway POST /v1/checkout returning 502 immediately after its client call to order:8000/v1/orders returns 500, across four correlated requests. Topology confirms gateway->order. This bounds the fault to the order service's 500 response; the underlying order-side cause is not yet observed.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for /v1/orders to identify the internal cause of the 500
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
